page_title: OutboundGateway - Static EU Outbound IPs for Your Applications

sources.entry: OutboundGateway - Static outbound IPs for AI agents and MCP servers. #paid

summary.name: OutboundGateway
summary.one_liner: A paid HTTPS (CONNECT) outbound proxy that gives applications stable, EU-hosted static IP addresses using SSL/TLS passthrough without decrypting traffic.
use_cases: Allowlisting a fixed IP with third-party APIs
Giving AI coding agents or MCP servers a static outbound IP
Routing Kubernetes or cloud workload egress through EU IPs
Meeting EU data residency needs for outbound API traffic
Partner integrations that require IP whitelisting
summary.what_it_does: OutboundGateway operates as an HTTPS (CONNECT) proxy with SSL/TLS passthrough, so the application's TLS connection goes directly to the destination and the proxy does not decrypt or modify it. Each proxy includes a pair of stable, load-balanced EU IP addresses, and the page says redundant pairs fail over automatically without configuration changes. Infrastructure is described as hosted in the EU. Proxy authentication is done over HTTPS. It works with any runtime that supports HTTPS proxies, such as cloud VMs, containers, and CI jobs.
notable: SSL/TLS passthrough: traffic is not decrypted, inspected, or modified by the proxy
Stable EU IP pairs with automatic failover, not rotating IPs
Hosted entirely in the European Union, with GDPR-aligned positioning
Works with any application that supports HTTPS proxies
caveats: Paid plans only: listed at €19, €59, and €220 per month, with bandwidth and request quotas
HTTPS proxies only; the page states it works with HTTPS only
Uptime is a 99.5% target, not a guaranteed SLA
Page text is inconsistent on trial length (free trial described as 7 days, with no free tier price)
